intro: "In the heart of a city reduced to ashes, the unstoppable operation of the elite special forces begins."
description:
Overwhelming realism delivered by a next-generation engine.

Welcome to <Special Forces: Blackout>, a next-generation FPS game that perfectly integrates near-future cutting-edge tactical mechanics onto the brutal realism of modern warfare.

Break through maze-like alleys where raining rockets and sniper gazes intersect, and infiltrate the heart of the enemy.

・Photorealistic Next-Generation Graphics for Overwhelming Immersion
The vivid realism of modern warfare, with artillery shells raining down, unfolds right before your eyes. Experience a whole new level of immersion in a lifelike battlefield recreated with cutting-edge graphics technology.

・Limitless Open World Battlefield and Free Tactical Design
The entire, endlessly stretching, vast battlefield becomes your board. There are no fixed routes. Forge your own path and lead the engagement based on your choices and judgment.

・Dynamic Vehicle Combat Using Mobile Gear
Board a variety of mobile vehicles and traverse the vast battlefield in an instant. With overwhelming mobility, you can seize tactical key points and turn the tide of battle in a flash.

・Four Elite Classes and Synergies to Complete Victory
We offer a class system featuring Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon, each equipped with unique tactical gear. Meticulous role assignments and perfect teamwork are the only keys to victory.

・A Collection of Legendary Squad Tactical Modes
Top-tier, proven game modes such as Deathmatch, Conquest, and Rush unfold. Prove your strategic spectrum, from capturing objectives to intense battles that generate extreme tension.

・Next-Generation Armored Forces Dominating the Battlefield
Take direct control of the main guns of state-of-the-art next-generation tanks. You can dominate the battlefield by instantly crushing solid enemy defenses or acting as a sturdy steel shield to protect friendly infantry on the front lines.

<Synopsis>
A massive modern city and the largest energy hub in the Middle East is isolated after being occupied by a mysterious, massive armed force. Amidst the gray ruins swallowed by red flames and sandstorms, the enemy occupies an old underground military base and is on the verge of activating the 'Apophis System,' a next-generation tactical weapon designed to plunge the world into terror.

In this worst-case scenario, where even major powers avoid official intervention to prevent a global catastrophe, elite special agents—who do not exist in this world—are secretly deployed into the heart of a chaotic desert city where visibility is obscured by smoke and dust.

"Unauthorized infiltration, traceless destruction. An operation from which no salvation can be expected."

Your infiltration becomes the formula that will shake the tide of the battlefield, and your single shot, pulled amidst the dust storm, becomes a legend that saves the world.
